items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Not really. Or he didn’t see me. [laughs] I’m trying to be funny. Yeah. [laughs] Yeah, those blind people, you know. [laughs] No. But he… we met afterwards. But that was a, a nice award [there?]. All our music that was $100,000… Every two years or every year, they choose a jazz artist to get an award. And that was the year Stevie got it. That’s it. That’s about all I got to say. And my, my credo is “Be yourself. No more, no less.” And to be yourself is not the easiest thing. Sometimes I get… some people tell me…
